user.title: Choose what to claim
user.description: Pick the energy sensor that measures your EV charging. A sensor that resets every day (like a smart plug's "Today's consumption") works best.

data_description.name: Used for the device name and the report folder, e.g. "EV charging".
data_description.energy_sensor: The sensor whose daily kWh go into the claim. This can't be changed later.
data_description.power_sensor: Optional. Only used to show whether the car is charging right now.
data_description.month_sensor: Optional. The plug's own month-to-date total, used to cross-check the ledger.

data.auto_generate: Generate the report automatically each month
data.generate_time: Report time on the 1st of the month
data.include_header: Include the header block in reports

data_description.rate: The home charging rate you claim, in AUD per kWh (up to 6 decimals).
data_description.vehicle: Optional. Shown in the report header, e.g. "Mitsubishi Outlander PHEV".
data_description.registration: Optional. Shown in the report header.
data_description.output_folder: Reports are saved under this folder in HA's media folder, one sub-folder per year.
data_description.notify_service: Optional. A notify action to call when a report is ready, e.g. notify.pushover.
data_description.include_header: Adds the title, vehicle, registration, period, data source and generated time above the tables.

error.invalid_rate: The rate must be greater than 0.
error.invalid_folder: Enter a relative folder path such as plug_and_claim/ev_charging (no ".." or backslashes).
error.notify_not_found: That notify action doesn't exist. Use the full name, e.g. notify.pushover.

abort.already_configured: There is already a claim for this energy sensor.

rate_from.title: When does the new rate apply?
rate_from.description:
You changed the rate from ${old_rate} to ${new_rate} per kWh. Months before the month you enter keep their earlier rate, so their claims don't change.

Current rates: {rates}.

data_description.effective_from: E.g. 2027-01. Entering a month that already has a rate replaces it.

error.invalid_rate: The rate must be greater than 0.
error.invalid_folder: Enter a relative folder path such as plug_and_claim/ev_charging (no ".." or backslashes).
error.notify_not_found: That notify action doesn't exist. Use the full name, e.g. notify.pushover.
error.invalid_month: Enter the month as YYYY-MM, e.g. 2027-01.

entry_not_found.message: No Plug & Claim claim with config entry ID {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: The claim {name} isn't loaded. Check it under Settings → Devices & services.

date_not_past.message: {date} isn't a completed day yet. Only past days can be set.

month_not_finished.message: {month} hasn't finished yet. Reports can only be generated for past months.

invalid_folder.message: The report folder {folder} is outside Home Assistant's media folder.

no_month_selected.message: There's no finished month in the ledger to report on yet.

sync.name: Sync ledger
sync.description: Updates the claim's daily kWh ledger from the recorder's long-term statistics. Returns the days it changed when called with a response.

config_entry_id.name: Claim
config_entry_id.description: The Plug & Claim claim to sync.

days_back.name: Days back
days_back.description: How many days back to re-read. Days in finalised months, and days set manually or imported, are left alone.

set_day.name: Set day
set_day.description: Sets one day's kWh by hand, e.g. to fill a gap or correct a reading. Manual values are never replaced by an automatic sync.

config_entry_id.name: Claim
config_entry_id.description: The Plug & Claim claim to change.

date.name: Date
date.description: The day to set (must be in the past).

generate_report.name: Generate report
generate_report.description: Writes the monthly claim report (XLSX and PDF) to the Media folder and records it. The month is then finalised, so automatic syncs leave it alone. Returns the totals and file paths when called with a response.

config_entry_id.name: Claim
config_entry_id.description: The Plug & Claim claim to report on.

month.name: Month
month.description: The month to report, as YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-09. It must have finished.

refresh_data.name: Refresh data
refresh_data.description: Re-read the month from the recorder first, even if it was finalised. Days you set by hand are kept.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Send the notification. Leave out to notify only if a notify action is set in the claim's settings.
